content_sections.heading: DCAC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
DCAC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DCAC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCAC Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks as per UGC Regulations, along with NET/Ph.D. as applicable. The eligibility criteria are the same as for regular Assistant Professors.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post, specifically for Journalism.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on a per-lecture basis, with Rs. 1500/- per lecture, capped at a maximum of Rs. 50000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the DCAC Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for the DCAC Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the DCAC office. The exact address is Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, University of Delhi, North Campus, New Delhi - 110023.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any further details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.
